findings.text: non-blocking: reachability is taken from the bare pid via process_alive, so a session whose record's pid has since been reused by another process reads reachable true while it has gone; the repository already joins a harness record's own procStart to the process table for exactly this reason at reckon/crew/fleet_migrate.py:170-178, and this reader also re-implements that file's session-record reader rather than extending it, so the guard is both available and beside the point where it is needed.

non-blocking: test_a_live_record_wins_over_the_one_a_resume_left_behind cannot fail on the preference it names, because both fixture records omit startedAt and the dead record's filename (2147483647.json) sorts before the live record's, so a last-wins loop without _preference at all produces the same live name and the assertion passes; giving the dead record a newer startedAt (or a later-sorting filename) would make the flag load-bearing.

non-blocking: section 11 asks for the name for each session that owns a live record, and a session with a harness record but no run whose stream carries an observed messaging_socket_path gets no transport entry and therefore no name, which the manifest records under outside_scope; it is the plan's own no-second-address-field constraint that forces the choice, so it is the plan owner's to restate rather than a defect in this diff.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 6 production call sites: the CLI and MCP readers of the directory view, the budget-reset reach reader, and the dispatch-watch host lookup and its two callers.
item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit 161456ebb2 against e689315bb7: it adds reckon/crew/harness_sessions.py, attaches it in directory.py, repoints dispatch_watch.py's directory read and crew_run_commands' live-session reader at it, and adds the gate test plus one import move.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_the_directory_gives_a_sessions_address.py with three cases; that file's four cases at lines 92-116 assert a live record's name and true flag, a dead record's name and false flag, and nulls for both; the manifest records the run and gate.log shows 4 passed in 3.42s with EXIT=0 at 161456ebb2.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is the directory view naming each session by the address peers message it, and reckon/crew/directory.py:763-780 attaches harness_sessions.addresses() onto every transport entry the row already carries, which is the plan section's named surface rather than a second field.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the manifest at the reviewed run's directory: it records status complete, commits 161456ebb2, the literal gate command, gate/negative-control/related logs, a waived-free negative control note, and rubric lines for all six dimensions.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the node's eight declared paths; all six paths in the diff (directory.py, dispatch_watch.py, harness_sessions.py, crew_run_commands, and the two test files) are inside them, and the declared evidence fragment and figures directories were not written, which is a subset rather than an escape.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_directory_gives_a_sessions_address.py:105-107 fails when the harness record is removed, as the negative control shows, but the resume case at line 134 does not discriminate the live-record preference.
justifications.evidence: gate.log's header names revision 161456ebb2 and its last line is EXIT=0 over 4 passed, and negative-control.log reddens the first case at tests/test_the_directory_gives_a_sessions_address.py:103 with EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/harness_sessions.py:29-60 names the directory, the env override and the reader by what they do, and reuses reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:process_alive rather than spelling a new liveness probe.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/directory.py:774-780 writes name and reachable onto each transport entry in reckon/crew/directory.py:766-771, which is the entry the plan named.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/harness_sessions.py:46-64 re-reads the harness session records that reckon/crew/fleet_migrate.py:136 has read since before this change, without extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff e689315bb7..161456ebb2 touches only the six declared source and test paths and no plan, state or figure path.
